bullets.text: Gigabit IQ Crowdfunds £270,000 - **Gigabit IQ** aims to accelerate expansion with £270,000 crowdfunding, already securing £243,650.
Vodafone Partners with Skylo - **Vodafone IoT** collaborates with **Skylo** to enhance IoT connectivity via satellite technology.
Zenture Disrupts Telecom Sourcing - **Zenture** transforms enterprise telecom with AI-driven data and automation for smarter decisions.
NEC Cuts 5G Power Draw - **NEC** introduces a compact amplifier module to reduce energy consumption in 5G networks.
TalkTalk Seeks Buyers - **TalkTalk** negotiates sale of its consumer ISP and wholesale platform, with potential bids from **VodafoneThree**.
Cisco Revamps Partner Program - **Cisco** launches the **Cisco 360 Partner Program** to enhance AI readiness and partner profitability.
Open Cosmos Launches Satellites - **Open Cosmos** activates its LEO constellation, marking a milestone in satellite telecom services.
AI Infrastructure Investment Rises - Telecom operators are increasingly investing in AI infrastructure to meet growing compute demands.
